metadata.title: SAR – SPF Lifecycle Management Gaps
metadata.remarks: Assessment result identifying institutional domains with SPF records that lack documented ownership, review cadence, or contain obsolete or undocumented senders, contrary to DNS Secure Email SSPP expectations.

findings.title: SPF Lifecycle Management Gaps
findings.description: One or more institutional domains publish SPF records that include undocumented, obsolete, or unreviewed senders, and lack defined ownership or lifecycle management.

associated-risk.title: Expanded Email Attack Surface
associated-risk.description: Overly permissive or stale SPF entries may allow abuse of dormant or unintended sending infrastructure.

remediations.title: Establish SPF Lifecycle Management
remediations.description: Document SPF ownership, review cadence, and remove obsolete or unauthorized senders in alignment with DNS Secure Email governance.

tasks.title: Identify SPF Ownership
tasks.description: Assign an accountable owner for each SPF record and associated sending authorization.

tasks.title: Review and Clean Up SPF Records
tasks.description: Review existing SPF entries, remove obsolete senders, and validate remaining authorized senders.

tasks.title: Define SPF Review Cadence
tasks.description: Establish and document a periodic SPF review and recertification process.
